title: Recent Payroll Points Schedule — Pocketwire Advance Card Repayment Share
content:
The customer's most recent payroll into the linked Pocketwire Personal Account adds points to the card repayment share of a past-due Pocketwire Advance line. When the linked personal account received direct deposits totalling at least the monthly direct deposit requirement of the line's tier from at least two deposits in the month before the handling date, 15 points are added to the share; when those deposits total at least half of that requirement without meeting both parts of the higher test, 5 points are added; otherwise the payroll adds nothing to the share. A point is one percentage point of the share.

**The window.** A window of one month before the handling date covers the records dated after the same day of the month one month before the handling date, up to and including the handling date.

**What is counted.** The direct deposit entries on the ledger of the linked Pocketwire Personal Account dated in the window: their total and their number.

## Thresholds by tier

| Tier of the line | Higher test (15 points): total of at least the requirement, from at least 2 deposits | Lower test (5 points): total of at least half the requirement |
|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Advance Starter | 300.00 | 150.00 |
| Pocketwire Advance Basic | 500.00 | 250.00 |
| Pocketwire Advance Standard | 800.00 | 400.00 |
| Pocketwire Advance Plus | 1200.00 | 600.00 |
| Pocketwire Advance Max | 1800.00 | 900.00 |
| Pocketwire Advance Elite | 2500.00 | 1250.00 |

The lower test has no count of deposits.

## Combinations (hypothetical line on Pocketwire Advance Plus)

| Deposits in the window | Total | Points added |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | 1200.00 | 15 |
| 1 | 1500.00 | 5 — one deposit fails the higher test |
| 3 | 900.00 | 5 — below 1200.00, at least 600.00 |
| 2 | 599.99 | Nothing |
